meta.scope: flags, banners and emblems only (artifacts are out of scope; see db/era_artifacts.json, owned by a teammate)
policy: Only attested state/official flags. No modern reconstructions or fantasy flags; reconstructed designs get flag null.
Armed-group flags (SAF, RSF, SPLM/A and others) are never shown, and no flag implies territorial control.
VERIFY = only Commons/Wikipedia; usage_source = an independent text actually read 2026-10-24
All flag images are modern SVG renderings of the attested design (badge MODERN_SVG_RENDERING)
display_hint "no known flag" = show a neutral emblem with no invented design
